name: striking-illuminance-prepare-2-declined-no-reveal-base-power
notes: Striking Illuminance (2lukkhisu5, LUXEM ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 2, printed power 4): "Prepare 2. Whenever you reveal a luxem element card from your memory, Striking Illuminance gets +1 POWER. On Attack: If Striking Illuminance was prepared, reveal all cards in your memory." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Player 2's memory is seeded with two Bathe in Light (LUXEM) before play; the two reserve payments add two NORM cards, so the reveal covers 4 memory cards of which exactly 2 are luxem. Player 2 declines Prepare 2: no reveal, no +POWER: printed 4 damage, counters untouched.

rulesClauses: On Attack: If Striking Illuminance was prepared, reveal all cards in your memory.
